name: produce embeddings that solve word-vector analogies and reflect semantic similarity
definition: Ensure that vector arithmetic (subtracting one embedding and adding another) ranks the expected relational word highly, and that semantically related pairs show positive cosine similarity.
failure_mode: Poorly structured embeddings fail to place the analogy target in the top results.

name: produce training output artifacts at an expected experiment data directory
definition: Ensure the training run writes its output (config and progress data) under the expected data/…/seed-n directory with real content.
failure_mode: Run truncated or saved elsewhere leaves the expected directory missing/empty.

name: respect one-use-only and allowed-number constraints
definition: Ensure every number used belongs to the given set and no number appears more than once in the expression.
failure_mode: Duplicates or an off-set number fails the count check.

name: run a multi-process distributed training function under the gloo backend
definition: Initialize and run a rank-aware distributed program spawned across N processes using CPU collective backend, with proper device/dtype movement.
failure_mode: Process-group init or device/dtype handling breaks execution
